title: Thumb-side wrist pain?
Doctors call it "texting thumb"
or "mommy thumb" — here's why
3 Habits That Protect Your Wrist Tendons

items.name: Why This Happens
body: a narrow tunnel at your wrist
get irritated by the same motion

items.name: Cause 1: Scrolling With Your Thumb
body: and scrolling with just your thumb

items.name: Use Both Hands Instead
body: Hold your phone with both hands
and use more than just your thumb

items.name: Cause 3: Lifting a Baby With Your Thumb
body: Do that dozens of times a day,
and the same tendons take the strain

items.name: Support the Weight With Your Palm
body: with your whole palm and forearm,

headline: Phone scrolling, gripping sports,
and holding a baby
Press your thumb into your palm and
bend your wrist — sharp pain there
is a self-check sign
tip: See a doctor if the pain lasts more
than two weeks or swelling gets heavy
